how_title: Three steps to a finished CV
how_step1_body: Layouts for every kind of job, from one calm column to a dense page with a sidebar. Switch whenever you like; your content stays put.
how_step2_body: Type straight onto the page, or paste your old CV or LinkedIn profile into the chat and the assistant sorts it into sections.
how_step3_body: Get a PDF or PNG that looks exactly like the editor, page breaks included. Sign up if you want to keep it for next time.

features_inline_line: Led the move to a new billing system

faq_ask_error: Couldn't answer that right now. Try again in a minute.
faq_ask_rate_limited: That's a lot of questions. Try again in a minute.
faq_q1: How does the AI edit my CV?
faq_a1: You write to it in the chat next to your CV, for example “shorten my summary” or “here is my LinkedIn, fill in my experience”. It makes the same edits you could make by hand, and you watch each one land on the page. You can undo any change, or select part of the page first so it only touches that part.
faq_q2: Does the AI see my data?
faq_a2: Only when you use the chat. Then your message and the text of your CV (not your photo) go to OpenAI to write the reply, plus any area of the page you clip. OpenAI does not use API data to train its models. Your CVs are stored on a Hetzner server in the EU; nothing is sold and there are no ads.
faq_q3: Will the AI make things up?
faq_a3: It is told never to invent employers, dates, degrees, numbers or achievements. When a bullet would be stronger with a figure, it asks you for one instead of guessing. Still, read what it writes before you send the CV: it only knows what you told it.
faq_q4: Which languages can it write in?
faq_a4: Most languages. Write in yours and the assistant answers and edits in it, section headings included. It can also translate a whole CV.
faq_a5: You can start for free, with no card to enter. The code is open source on GitHub.
faq_a6: No. Start as a guest and your CVs stay in this browser. Sign up with email or Google to keep them for good and open them on other devices; anything you made as a guest moves to your account.
faq_q7: Will my PDF pass applicant tracking systems?
faq_a7: The PDF is printed by a real browser engine, so the words are real, selectable text with embedded fonts, not a picture of text, and tracking systems can read it. For very strict portals, pick the ATS template: one plain column with standard headings.
faq_a8: Both. Change the paper size in the page settings and the layout reflows. The page breaks you see in the editor are the page breaks in the download.
faq_q9: How do I delete my account?
faq_a9: You can delete any CV yourself from My CVs. To delete your account and everything in it, email {email} and it will be done.
